result:
I added `created_at` as the last column in `toCsv` (`src/exports/csvExport.ts`). Each row's value is `createdAt.toISOString()`, so dates come out in a stable UTC format like `2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z`. I haven't run it or any tests.

This changes the CSV format, and the team notes say to tag @jordan on PRs that change export formats. Since the new column goes at the end, existing consumers that read columns by position shouldn't break.
